title: Understand
question: What behavior is being asked for, and what must not change?
body: Locate the symbols, modules, tests and contracts involved. Separate observed facts from inferred assumptions. Read the repository's policy before the code.
checks: Every claim cites a path or command

title: Plan
question: What is the smallest independently verifiable unit?
body: Choose one reviewable change. Name the tests that will prove it, the security and compatibility risks, and the rollback. Decide whether the work can run in parallel.
checks: The plan has a failing test or a characterization test

title: Establish baseline
question: What is already broken, and what does measurable good look like?
body: Run the relevant existing checks before editing. Record pre-existing failures separately. Add characterization tests where coverage is thin and a performance baseline before optimizing.
checks: Baseline uses the repository's authoritative command
Pre-existing failures are not attributed to the change

title: Implement
question: Can this be smaller, reversible and inside the owned boundary?
body: Make the smallest change that satisfies the requirement. Preserve architecture and contracts unless the task explicitly changes them. Keep formatting, refactoring and behavior in separate steps.
outputs: Updated contract or migration when required

title: Verify
question: What actually ran, and what does the evidence prove?
body: Run format, lint, type, unit and integration checks. Run contract, property, fuzz or differential checks where the surface warrants it. Review the final diff. A check that did not run is unverified, not passed.
checks: The regression test fails before the fix and passes after
Skipped or blocked checks are reported
The final diff has no surprises

title: Report
question: What changed, what was proven, and what remains uncertain?
body: Report the change, requirements satisfied, commands executed, failures, skips, security considerations, performance effect and residual risk. Link the evidence record. Do not present a model summary as a check result.
checks: Every pass has an exit code or record
The report states the limit as plainly as the feature
